rows.estimation_basis: Estimates are grounded in historical metrics from reference project '001-logistics-fleet-portal' (3,400 hours total delivery effort). Modules for Live Map (360-440h vs 420h ref), Alerts Engine (340-420h vs 380h ref), Vehicle/Route CRUD (200-260h vs 240h ref), and Reporting (280-360h vs 360h ref) closely track reference benchmarks adjusted for waste-collection specific geofencing and stop-completion logic. Telematics ingestion effort is adjusted down (280-360h vs 520h ref) because the scope integrates a single hardware vendor rather than three, though it retains full queuing and buffering architecture. Auth is benchmarked at 140-180h (160h ref) for 3-municipality isolation. DevOps and QA/Stabilisation represent proportionate human delivery effort (700-880h combined) reflecting comprehensive field testing and UAT.

No reference projects were provided. Estimates are derived bottom-up based on standard engineering lifecycle data for commercial IoT fleet tracking systems. Hours incorporate cross-functional team execution including architecture, backend streaming, PostGIS spatial modeling, frontend visualization, quality assurance with telemetry replay simulation, and production stabilization.

Estimates are directly grounded in Reference Project '002-fintech-kyc-onboarding' (KYC Onboarding Platform for a Digital Bank, total 5,200 hours, 26 weeks). The current project scope matches the reference platform's core domains: document capture, automated watchlist checks, an async processing pipeline with Celery/FastAPI, manual review queues, and an append-only audit trail. The scope has been adjusted downward from 5,200 hours to approximately 2,700–3,460 hours (22 weeks with a cross-functional team) because the credit union's scope excludes multi-jurisdiction passport validation, complex cross-border banking entities, and mobile native apps, focusing instead on a single-jurisdiction web onboarding workflow.

No historical reference projects were provided by the client. The estimates are synthesized bottom-up based on standard enterprise engineering metrics for regulated fintech systems, accounting for full lifecycle effort including discovery, system architecture, third-party vendor integration, rigorous multi-tier testing, security hardening, and regulatory audit trail validation.

Estimates are strictly calibrated using historical metrics from reference project '003-ecommerce-b2b-marketplace' (6,100 hours total delivery effort). Specific module parallels were leveraged: the Catalogue Import Pipeline (620h) served as the baseline for the spreadsheet ingestion worker (560-640h); Search & Faceted Filtering (540h) informed our equipment filtering engine (480-560h); the Quote Workflow (780h) mapped directly to the Enquiry/Offer negotiation module (680-780h); the Stripe Connect split payments module (700h) informed deposit processing (640-720h); the Supplier Portal (820h) informed the Dealer Portal (740-840h); and QA/UAT (920h) and DevOps (380h) were maintained in similar proportion. The 480h enterprise punch-out integration was excluded as it is not required for this machinery marketplace.

No historical reference projects were provided for this brief. The estimates are synthesized bottom-up based on standard engineering baselines for multi-sided B2B marketplace platforms. Effort allocations explicitly incorporate end-to-end delivery phases: product discovery, user experience architecture, spreadsheet parsing resilient to malformed data, Stripe Connect split-payment infrastructure, automated testing, DevOps provisioning, and stakeholder acceptance testing.

Estimates are strictly derived from past reference project 004-healthcare-patient-app (total 3,900 hours, 22 weeks), which implemented a similar Flutter, FastAPI, and Twilio Video stack for clinic networks. Module effort was calibrated to match the reference: Appointment Scheduling (520h reference vs 460-540h estimated), Video Consultation (380h reference vs 350-420h estimated), Mobile App Core (900h reference vs 750-880h estimated), Secure Messaging/Notifications (420h reference vs 360-430h estimated), Doctor/Therapist Dashboard (560h reference vs 500-600h estimated), Security/Audit (300h reference vs 280-340h estimated), and QA/App Store (340h reference vs 300-360h estimated). Because clinic-wide EHR FHIR integration was not explicitly mandated in the brief, that effort was reallocated toward the specialized Home Rehabilitation and Exercise Regimen tracking module (320-380h) and dedicated DevOps/IaC engineering (240-300h), yielding a realistic delivery estimate of 3,560 - 4,250 total engineering hours across 22 calendar weeks.

Estimates are directly benchmarked against Reference Project 005-hr-internal-ai-assistant (1,500 total hours across 10 weeks). While the HR reference handled ~400 general documents, this project scales to ~1,500 technical standards and project reports containing complex tables and structural hierarchies, increasing Document Ingestion and Hybrid Retrieval scope. The Access Control module is expanded from 180h to 200-240h to accommodate dynamic Microsoft Entra ID group synchronization and project membership mapping across past project reports. Chat UI and Quality Evaluation match the proven reference baseline, adjusted for engineering-specific PDF viewing capabilities and domain-specific validation.

Estimates are directly benchmarked against Reference Project 008-mobile-field-service (Offline-First Field Service App for Technicians, 3600h, 21 weeks). Historical baseline hours were reused and adjusted for corresponding modules: Offline data layer and sync (760h reference vs 680-760h here), Checklists and forms (520h reference vs 480-540h here), Photo/signature capture queue (300h reference vs 280-320h here), Push notifications & background sync (200h reference vs 180-210h here), QA and pilot testing (400h reference vs 360-420h here), and DevOps/store release (260h reference vs 240-280h here). The reference's back-office dispatch console and complex ERP integrations were replaced by the Client's requested Customer Web Portal (380-440h) and automated Invoice PDF generation/download service (240-280h), maintaining consistent total project delivery effort including QA, DevOps, and project stabilization.

Estimates are directly grounded in historical data from Reference Project '007-edtech-lms' (2,800 hours total). We retained baseline estimates for User Management/SSO (~220h), Video Delivery (~300h), Quizzes/Exams (~340h), Manager Reporting (~280h), and DevOps/QA (~400h). Because SCORM package importing (420h) is not required, it was completely removed. Course authoring and general learning paths were streamlined down to core mandatory compliance paths. We added a dedicated Pre-Exam Identity Verification and Audit Proof module (320-400h) to handle external IdP API integration, biometric audit capture, and WORM-compliant storage.
